title: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Chiang Mai
description: Discover Chiang Mai's top natural wine bars for unique biodynamic and organic selections. From trendy spots to hidden gems, find your next favorite glass in Northern Thailand.

places.name: Nueragym
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the sommelier for a bespoke natural wine pairing with their Wagyu Tataki or the Thai-style Tuna Tartare.

places.name: Renegade Craft Beer & Natural Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their unique orange wines by the glass, paired with the Truffle Fries.

places.name: Charin
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal Tasting Menu with the recommended natural wine flight is a must-try for a full experience.

places.name: Sorn-Lek Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Let the friendly staff suggest a unique natural wine based on your preferences, and definitely get the artisanal cheese board.

places.name: Baantok
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for the chef's seasonal tasting menu, as it's designed around the freshest local ingredients and paired with their natural wines.

places.name: Lamoon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair their signature Gaeng Phet Ped Yang (roasted duck red curry) with a bold natural red, or a light skin-contact white.

places.name: The Wine Republic
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their 'Natural & Organic' section on the wine list and pair it with their hearty pasta dishes or a selection of cold cuts.

places.name: Food & Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their seasonal risotto or a fresh seafood dish, and ask the server for a natural wine pairing – they're quite knowledgeable.

places.name: Arun Cafe & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a glass of their current natural red or white with a simple Bruschetta or a fresh salad.

places.name: The Service 1921 Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Indulge in a multi-course Thai Royal set menu and ask the sommelier for their recommendations from the natural wine list.

places.name: Gekko Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair their Hamachi Carpaccio or assorted Sashimi with a crisp, mineral-driven natural white or an elegant orange wine.

places.name: Graph Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask about their current natural wine by the glass, and pair it with one of their unique fusion desserts or a simple pastry.
